caption: The drawing depicts a detailed, ornate object that appears to be a woven basket with an arrangement of botanical elements emerging from its top. The lower portion is a ribbed, vertically lined basket shape, rendered in shades of gray with touches of brown, suggesting age or wear. Above the basket, the composition includes an assortment of large stylized leaves, buds, berries, and a central flower with prominent petals and a textured center. All elements are meticulously shaded in gray tones, with brownish-yellow highlights or spots indicating areas where the surface appears chipped or worn. The background is a plain, light beige color with no other objects or details.
title: Carved Ornament
